annotations.title: Where an ETF portfolio's risk comes from

description: For a list of US ETFs: portfolio volatility, each position's share of the risk (Euler decomposition, summing to 100), the diversification ratio, and the correlation and covariance matrices of weekly returns over up to three years.

currency.description: The currency of the amounts, for example USD. Echoed back; nothing is converted.

positions.description: The funds in the portfolio. Amounts are optional; with none, every fund counts equally.

amount.description: What this line is worth, in one currency for all lines.

ticker.description: A US ETF ticker, for example VOO. Case does not matter.

name: risk_decomposition
title: Where an ETF portfolio's risk comes from
